0022600132.text: Miami enters 0-3 on a three-game losing streak, sitting 5th in the Southeast and 2 games back, and 15th in the East, while Atlanta is 2-1, 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East after a recent loss. The Hawks are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both listed as out, and the Heat are 0-1 on the road while Atlanta is 0-1 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Heat won the series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12.
